interface.title: AlgaTwin / Virtual Photobioreactor (v0.8.2.dev0)
interface.field: Microalgal biotechnology / bioprocess modelling (photobioreactor growth kinetics)
interface.stage_of_work: Analysis of batch-culture time series: fitting a model, checking whether its parameters can be estimated, and writing a report; also simulation of model variants for teaching and scenario planning
interface.what_it_is_for: A simulator and parameter-calibration prototype for microalgal photobioreactors. It fits Monod-type nitrogen- and light-limited growth models to batch-culture biomass and nitrate data, checks whether each parameter can be estimated using profile-likelihood intervals, and exports a report that records where everything came from. It also simulates model variants and operating conditions. Other workspaces cover model comparison and next-experiment planning, OD/cell-count calibration, joint calibration across runs, and light × nitrogen scenario planning.

data.note: I uploaded synthetic_chlorella_demo.csv (13 time points; columns time_day, biomass_g_L, nitrate_n_mg_L) in the Guided workspace and labelled it SYNTHETIC. The app ships no checked literature parameters for C. minutissima. Every fixed parameter was the app's default synthetic teaching assumption. I typed the initial conditions myself: X0=0.1, N0=70, light=200, path=0.05 m (screens/016.webp; the replay typed 180 for light). I also typed the yield search bounds: 4–15, starting value 8.
